profile.headline: Software Engineer 2 at The Home Depot
profile.summary:
Before transitioning into software engineering, I worked as a Customer Service Manager, where I coached and mentored young adults, helping them develop strong communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

Today, I am a Software Engineer II at The Home Depot, specializing in front-end development and digital experiences. I enjoy building user-focused solutions with JavaScript, React, and Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), and I collaborate closely with engineering, business, and creative teams to deliver impactful customer experiences through web and email platforms.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description: Skills: Software Development · JavaScript · React.js · Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) · Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Development · JavaScript · React.js · Engineering

positions.title: Implementation Engineer
positions.description:
Integrated code fragments into client applications to boost customer engagement with Virtual Try-On (VTO), Augmented Reality (AR), and 3D experiences

Designed page layouts tailored to client specifications, driving increased transaction revenue

Published SKUs via command-line interface (CLI), deploying experiences to client checkout flows and marketing pages

positions.title: Software Engineer Immersive Resident
positions.description:
Selected by staff to serve as the “Shepherd” of the Austin campus, responsible for monitoring student progress and supporting them in passing their Technical Assessment to advance to the senior phase

Instructed multiple student cohorts in JavaScript fundamentals, including leading code reviews and facilitating review groups

Strengthened personal debugging skills through one-on-one tutoring sessions with students

positions.title: Sales Lead
positions.description:
Oversaw daily operations across two locations, including managing payroll and coordinating shipments

Led monthly management meetings focused on driving sales growth and revenue

Provided one-on-one coaching to associates to strengthen their customer service and communication skills

positions.title: Customer Service Manager
positions.description:
Trained new associates in customer service best practices, emphasizing the importance of creating meaningful first impressions

Supervised inventory and delegated tasks to over 10 employees during floor-set projects to ensure smooth execution

Participated in monthly district conference calls to identify growth opportunities and performance improvements for the team

honors.title: Creating Shareholder Value
honors.description: Proud moment receiving a Homer Award alongside my fellow engineer for resolving a business‑impacting analytics issue. This was a great example of how strong collaboration, persistence, and ownership can directly drive meaningful business outcomes. Moments like this reinforce the value of teamwork, thoughtful problem‑solving, and staying customer‑focused. Grateful to be part of the AEM Squad that truly lives these values.
honors.issuer: Issued by Morgan Bailey - Software Engineer Manager · Feb 2026

honors.title: Doing the Right Thing
honors.description: The AEM Squad collaborated to resolve complex email rendering issues. These efforts were critical to the success of our launches and meeting release deadlines.
honors.issuer: Issued by Bennie Boone - Software Engineer Manager · Oct 2025
